payload.title: IPv4 packets
payload.summary: Validate variable IPv4 header boundaries and checksums, construct portable headers, and apply an atomic router-style TTL update.

prerequisites: Fixed-width C17 integers, size_t, arrays, const, shifts, and network-order 16-bit values
Basic datagram, payload, protocol-number, and one's-complement checksum concepts
outcomes: Decode bounded IPv4 headers and derive checked option and payload spans
Verify variable-length header checksums and construct exact headers without layout assumptions
Decrement TTL and repair the checksum while preserving invalid or expired input

checks: Validate fixed and variable boundaries before decoding or publishing any output
Distinguish malformed declarations from unavailable bytes and include options in the checksum
Keep failed builds and TTL updates atomic while matching deterministic fixtures

allowed: Bounded in-memory IPv4 parsing, construction, and TTL mutation
Copied host-side fields and checked offset-length spans
Pinned Linux v6.6 source as provenance and conceptual comparison
excluded: Network access, raw sockets, packet capture, or external commands
Fragment reassembly, packet transmission, or route selection
Trust, authentication, or authorization decisions from parse success
